correction_reason: The initially listed intraday families were structurally duplicative of prior independent price-action and activity-release audits. They were replaced before GU1 outcomes were calculated.

selection_design.selection_rule: Among families passing every discovery gate, select exactly one with highest discovery PF; tie within 0.01 PF goes to lower max DD, then lexicographic family id. If none pass, stop with no candidate.
selection_design.evaluation_rule: Run the selected frozen family unchanged on all untouched evaluation periods. Do not select a different family after seeing evaluation results.

D1_H4_ALIGNMENT_BREAK.direction: D1 EMA20 slope sign equals H4 EMA20 slope sign after the prior closed H4 bar was not aligned
D1_H4_ALIGNMENT_BREAK.intraday_confirmation: first closed M15 close beyond the prior 16 closed M15 bar high or low in the aligned direction

D1_VOL_EXPANSION_CONTINUATION.direction: sign of the closed D1 candle body
D1_VOL_EXPANSION_CONTINUATION.regime_onset: D1 ATR14 divided by past-only rolling 60-D1 median crosses from below 1.15 to at least 1.15 and absolute D1 body is at least 0.50 ATR14
D1_VOL_EXPANSION_CONTINUATION.intraday_confirmation: first closed M15 close beyond the prior 8 closed M15 bar high or low in the D1 direction

H4_RANGE_TO_TREND_PULLBACK.direction: sign of H4 close minus EMA20
H4_RANGE_TO_TREND_PULLBACK.regime_onset: H4 Kaufman efficiency ratio over 20 closed H4 bars crosses from at most 0.20 to at least 0.35 while EMA20 slope has the same sign
H4_RANGE_TO_TREND_PULLBACK.intraday_confirmation: first M15 pullback touching EMA20 followed by a close beyond the previous M15 extreme in the regime direction

D1_EXHAUSTION_REVERSAL.direction: opposite the prior D1 candle body
D1_EXHAUSTION_REVERSAL.regime_onset: closed D1 true range at least 1.80 ATR14, directional wick at least 45 percent of range, and close back inside the previous closed D1 range
D1_EXHAUSTION_REVERSAL.intraday_confirmation: first closed M15 close through the exhaustion D1 midpoint in the reversal direction

D1_H4_DISAGREEMENT_RESOLUTION.direction: existing closed D1 EMA20 slope sign
D1_H4_DISAGREEMENT_RESOLUTION.regime_onset: H4 EMA20 slope sign changes to the D1 sign after at least three consecutive closed H4 bars of opposite nonzero sign
D1_H4_DISAGREEMENT_RESOLUTION.intraday_confirmation: first closed M15 close beyond the prior 12 closed M15 bar high or low in the resolved direction
